newsitem.title: INDIA: IMF's Camdessus asks India's RBI to watch inflation.
newsitem.headline: IMF's Camdessus asks India's RBI to watch inflation.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) managing director Michel Camdessus on Wednesday urged India's central bank to be vigilant in order to check inflation.
"The (inflation) trend is upward. We believe that this requires vigilance from the central bank to avoid any slipages in the prices," Camdessus told a news conference.
India's inflation rate, measured by the wholesale price index (WPI), stood at 7.99 percent on February 15 compared with 4.60 percent a year earlier.
Camdessus urged the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), the central bank, to cautiously watch the upward march of prices.
"We would like to see more progress towards inflation control and better balance between monetary policy and budgetary policy," Camdessus said.
